purpose: Test whether each structurally eligible family x trait system has enough observed phylogenetic and geographic geometry to recover the predeclared null-centered turnover effect before any real trait effect is computed.

canonical_effect.name: delta_rho
canonical_effect.estimator: Spearman(separation, state_dissimilarity); under the frozen complete-label trait permutation null, the exact null mean is zero, so this equals delta_rho exactly

simulation_scope.run_only_after: v0.2.2 structural support PASS, v0.3.3 state-validity PASS, and v0.3.4 phylogeny crosswalk PASS
geometry_inputs_only: patristic distances from the frozen S3 TPL tree
eligible measurement coordinates grouped by species

continuous_scalar_generator.latent_model: zero-mean Gaussian process on the observed separation geometry with exponential covariance exp(-d/lambda)
continuous_scalar_generator.temporal_geometry: patristic distance divided by the median positive pairwise patristic distance within the family x trait geometry before GP covariance construction; the Spearman estimator itself remains scale invariant
continuous_scalar_generator.spatial_geometry: within-species great-circle distance divided by that species' median positive pairwise distance before covariance construction

calibration.search: deterministic log-spaced bracket followed by bisection on log(lambda)
calibration.failure_rule: if the benchmark cannot be bracketed on the frozen range, classify the geometry as INFORMATIVENESS_HOLD rather than changing the generator
calibration.effect_computation: use the exact-zero-null identity, so synthetic delta_rho is the observed synthetic Spearman rho without Monte Carlo null-mean noise

nominal_categorical_generator.latent_model: same Gaussian-process generator followed by a zero-threshold into a balanced binary synthetic state
nominal_categorical_generator.rationale: balanced binary mismatch is a conservative pre-value benchmark that does not require inspecting the real number or frequency of categories
nominal_categorical_generator.calibration: same fixed benchmark, bracket, pilot count, bisection tolerance and failure rule as continuous_scalar

temporal_estimator.continuous_state: one synthetic state per eligible species
temporal_estimator.categorical_state: one synthetic binary state per eligible species
temporal_estimator.null: exact permutation mean = 0 by the frozen trait-null theorem; 999 random permutations are retained only for null-dispersion / implementation diagnostics on a fixed synthetic replicate
temporal_estimator.backbone_native_requirement: repeat the entire simulation on prune-only tips; both S3 and prune-only geometries must pass admission thresholds

spatial_estimator.species_effect: one delta_rho per eligible spatial species using its observed coordinate geometry
spatial_estimator.null: within each species, exact complete-label permutation mean = 0; 999 permutations are retained only for null-dispersion / implementation diagnostics

recovery_definition.median_absolute_recovery_error: median absolute error across the 1000 evaluation replicates
recovery_definition.directional_recovery: fraction of evaluation replicates with estimated delta_rho > 0
recovery_definition.joint_system_pass: temporal S3, temporal prune-only, and spatial estimators each satisfy median absolute error <=0.10, directional recovery >=0.80, and valid replicate fraction >=0.90
recovery_definition.valid_replicate: rho is finite and pairwise synthetic state dissimilarity has nonzero rank variance
recovery_definition.valid_replicate_fraction: fraction of the 1000 evaluation replicates that are valid
recovery_definition.invalid_replicate_treatment: invalid replicates count as directional-recovery failures; median absolute error is computed over valid replicates only, and the geometry is HOLD if valid fraction <0.90

randomization.seed_rule: derive deterministic per-family x trait x axis seeds from the UTF-8 system key plus master seed; never rerun with alternate seeds to change eligibility
randomization.null_permutations_role: diagnostic null SD / empirical-zero check only; never used to estimate the primary null mean

finite_decision_rule.pass: system proceeds to real trait-value computation only if all required geometry simulations pass
finite_decision_rule.hold: system is excluded from H1/H2 if any required geometry simulation fails
